families.label: Interlocked marker

observed_letters.A: Two triangular diagonals crossed by a heavy slash; structural crossing runs beyond the left leg
observed_letters.M: An asymmetric tall peak retains a triangular opening despite multiple crossing gestures

families.evidence: Artist-named tags in tags50 demonstrate word-level dominant forms; KENO explicitly favours fluent legibility and minimal frills.
families.next_measure: Trace 2-3 actual exit-to-entry transitions in writer-identified tags and count crossing strokes per full word
families.do_not: Do not randomly remove hairlines from every glyph or assign a decorative slash to every letter.

families.label: Arrow-cross / source-mismatch audit

observed_letters.A: Loosely open triangular peak; thin crossing stroke; the lower counter is not filled
observed_letters.O: Broad handdrawn ring pierced by a horizontal bar and a short central echo

families.evidence: The uploaded primary is thin and skeletal; current heavy arrow-cross rendering contradicts it. FAUST demonstrates a separate chisel/blackletter signature discipline but does not authenticate sheet 7.
families.next_measure: Compare a thin-source reconstruction against current heavy design; re-anchor heavy style if retained rather than claiming sheet 7 is fat-marker evidence
families.do_not: Do not call the heavy arrow-cross renderer a faithful transcription of sheet 7.

families.label: Cut-wedge angular

observed_letters.M: Unequal black wedge rises form a tight broken zigzag rather than three font stems
observed_letters.K: Acute thick blade intersections with narrow cut-out slits

families.evidence: The supplied sheet visibly uses massive angular blades; TEMPO documents preference for hard-edged letterforms. TEMPO photos contain pieces, so confirm full-tag evidence separately.
families.next_measure: Compare blade angles, visible counters and directional balance in whole 4-8 letter word; retain current decisive silhouette
families.do_not: Do not smooth points into generic rounded throw-up letters.

families.label: Rectilinear block

observed_letters.O: Heavy squared perimeter with a smaller hard-edged central cavity
observed_letters.E: Three shelves differ in length and angle; not mathematically identical rectangles

families.evidence: Visible sheet has straight dominant bars but hand-placed shelf irregularity; 2025 writer-named photographed gallery includes clipped simple tags.
families.next_measure: Record exact deviations from straightness and terminal overshoots on at least two tagged names
families.do_not: Do not turn block into a mechanical stencil or apply random texture.

families.label: Fractured Gothic

observed_letters.A: Tall blade plus narrow pointed arch; hairline is secondary
observed_letters.M: Two tall tapering uprights with compressed asymmetric notch; not three isolated I minims

families.evidence: FAUST explicitly distinguishes chisel, script and blackletter approaches; Shoe demonstrates physically scaled calligraphic gestures. Neither proves authorship of uploaded sheet 29.
families.next_measure: On H/M/N record top shoulders, joins and counter cuts that differentiate one word; remove decorative midline only if unsupported by actual marks
families.do_not: Do not use generic spiked typefaces as the model.

families.label: Broad-nib calligraffiti

observed_letters.A: Heavy ribbon upright with a very thin returning outside loop
observed_letters.S: Ribbon turns produce clear wide/thin contrast and a light runout

families.evidence: Artist's portfolio shows brush-created word images; first-person hand/wrist/arm mechanics explicitly depend on instrument/scale.
families.next_measure: Map local tangent versus broad nib orientation on a whole word to predict where broad vs fine mark must occur
families.do_not: Do not vary width by letter name alone.

families.label: Rotational loops

observed_letters.O: Flattened enclosing oval includes a smaller eye loop
observed_letters.G: Outer rotational circuit is interrupted by a cross bridge and returned tail

families.evidence: Photographed EARSNOT mop tag shows dominant loops, swing and drips; GOREY named tag gallery supplies one-line contrasting comparator. The two sources are not the sheet's authors.
families.next_measure: Mark major loop(s) and terminating direction in a complete tag; distinguish intentional orbit from an equal wobble on every letter
families.do_not: Do not mechanically cap every letter at two paths.

families.label: Fragmented brush

observed_letters.A: Separate angular red ribbons leave triangular omissions and detached top ends
observed_letters.K: Letter identity arises from three separated blade groups rather than a single outline

families.evidence: The uploaded sample directly verifies sharp separated brush-like forms; photographed tags in tags50 distinguish necessary pen lifts from gratuitous noise.
families.next_measure: Annotate exact dry-lift gap and free negative spaces in every proposed revision to A K M S
families.do_not: Do not insert an automatic break every fixed distance.

families.label: Angular chisel gestures

observed_letters.A: Cyan upright trunk topped by a small offset headcut; almost no closed counter
observed_letters.O: Narrow teardrop-shaped open silhouette made from two tapered edges

families.evidence: Sheet confirms few-pass trunk-and-cut structure, FAUST first-person account confirms practice with chisel-tip markers; no attribution link asserted.
families.next_measure: Study actual chisel-tip entry face and hard taper on M N R O before rewriting whole alphabet
families.do_not: Do not bulk thicken or add rounded loops to this sparse hand.

review_protocol.release: No V2 font code or production atlas modifications until full-tag links and observations have been reviewed
